Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 14, 2026 — SocialPulse by Dotstark Technologies

This policy explains how SocialPulse handles data when you connect LinkedIn (including your personal profile and your LinkedIn Company Page via a business account) and other platforms.

1. Data we access

  • LinkedIn OAuth: name, email, member ID (OpenID), and the access token you grant. If you grant Company Page access, we also read the list of organizations you administrate (organizationAcls) and basic organization info to let you pick the publishing target.
  • Content you create: captions, hashtags, images/videos you upload or generate, and scheduling metadata.
  • Other platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Canva): analogous tokens and page/design IDs, only when you connect them.

2. How we use it

  • Authenticate you and publish/schedule posts only to the accounts/pages you select and confirm.
  • Generate AI content/images you request (topic → caption/hashtags via Inception/NVIDIA; images via Pollinations).
  • Never post automatically without your explicit Publish/Schedule action; no auto-retry.

3. Storage

OAuth tokens are stored server-side only, in the database and never in browser storage or URLs. They are not logged or returned to the client. Drafts, scheduled posts and saved media are stored server-side and are scoped to your account: no other user can read, modify or preview them, and knowing an asset id is not enough to access it. Saved media (uploads, AI-generated images, Canva imports, branded variants) is retained for 30 days and then removed.

4. Sharing

We do not sell your data. Data is sent only to the platform APIs you authorize (LinkedIn, Facebook/Instagram Graph, Canva, and AI providers listed in our model docs) for the single purpose of completing your request.

5. Disconnect & deletion

  • Disconnect any platform at any time via the app (Account card → Disconnect) — this deletes the server token immediately.
  • You can also revoke access directly in LinkedIn > Settings > Permitted services or Meta Business Suite > Integrations.
  • Contact us to delete all stored data: privacy@dotstark.tech

6. Retention

Tokens are kept until you disconnect or they expire/revoke. Generated content lives in your browser draft/history until you clear it; scheduled-post records are kept locally until you cancel them.

7. Contact

Dotstark Technologies, Software Development, 51–200 employees — LinkedIn Page verified Sep 7, 2026.
Email: privacy@dotstark.tech · Web: socialpulse.dotstark.tech

LinkedIn Company Page posting: when you authorize w_organization_social, you are granting SocialPulse permission to create organic posts to the LinkedIn Company Page(s) you administrate, only when you click Publish/Schedule in the Studio. We never post to a Page you did not select.
